Step: 1959 is not a leap year (1959 not divisible by 4).  
277 days back from 1959-07-05:  
July 5 → June 5: 30 days (June has 30) → 277 - 30 = 247 left.  
June 5 → May 5: 31 days (May) → 247 - 31 = 216 left.  
Continue backward month by month through 1959 and into 1958.  

Month-by-month subtraction:  
April 5: 30 days → 216 - 30 = 186  
March 5: 31 days → 186 - 31 = 155  
February 5: 28 days (1959 not leap) → 155 - 28 = 127  
January 5: 31 days → 127 - 31 = 96  
December 5, 1958: 31 days → 96 - 31 = 65  
November 5, 1958: 30 days → 65 - 30 = 35  
October 5, 1958: 31 days → 35 - 31 = 4  
Go back 4 more days from October 5 → October 1, 1958.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1958-10-01
